run_annotate_labeled_scenes_cli: run the annotate_labeled_scenes CLI tool to re-annotate unannotated scenes from given batch IDs interactively
run_main_function: run the main function with a list of batch IDs and timeout to merge and re-annotate unannotated scenes
create_vision_annotation_job: create a VisionAnnotationJob with a batch ID, timestamp, scene list, and timeout for re-annotation
register_and_run_task_runner: register a VisionAnnotationJob as a data generator on a TaskRunner and execute it
generate_batch_id: generate a unique batch ID string for tracking annotation job runs
